name: ANSI/IEEE Clock indication form
summary: IEEE-library form of clock indication: a clock indication identifies a time display or clock function in the circuit documentation.
description: This reference locates clock indication in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented instrumentation and sensors family. A clock indication identifies a time display or clock function in the circuit documentation. The public library uses HIN1P29 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.
